## SourceStudy.kt { #sourcestudy-kt }

The language-neutral half of a live-code study: the part of "talking a function into existence"
that does not care what the language is.

A study holds one editable source — the text in a box that a person and a model are both working
on — and a durable, append-only history of the versions of it that passed a check. Every change
arrives as a *transaction*: the caller names the revision it read and a hash of the live source it
read, the candidate is checked by the language adapter, and only then is it written into the box,
with a compare-and-swap against the text that is there *now*. So a model preparing an edit while a
person types cannot overwrite the person, a candidate that fails its check changes nothing, and
every accepted version can be read back, compared and restored.

What the language adds is one function, [`SourceStudy`](workspace.md#sourcestudy-kt-sourcestudy)'s `admit`: compile and check a candidate,
returning a value (whatever the language's tools need — a composition, a compiled shader report)
or throwing [`StudyRejection`](workspace.md#sourcestudy-kt-studyrejection) with a message a person or a model can act on. `afield.stacksl.study`
is the first adapter; `FunctionStudy` predates this class and implements the same protocol with the
same file layout, so a revision directory written by either reads the same way.

### On disk

`directory/<id>.<extension>` is a revision's source and `directory/<id>.json` its metadata (parent,
description, time, and whatever facts the adapter chose to keep). `directory/HEAD` names the checked
revision the box last held. An id is `r<n>-<first 12 hex of SHA-256(source)>`, so an id also
verifies its own file: a revision whose source was edited on disk refuses to load.

This is trusted local code, not a sandbox: `admit` runs whatever the adapter runs. Cancellation
(`cancel`) stops a pending publication, not a computation that never checks for it.

## props.kt { #props-kt }

The `prop` / `rootProp` macro pair — the typed, inheritable box-property slot.

`prop` and `rootProp` exist only as the declarations that make `prop<Int>(foo)` resolve; neither
is meant to run, and calling one throws `MacroRegistry.MacroNotExpandedException`. The real work
happens at expansion time in `macro_prop` and `macro_root_prop`, which are handed the type
argument and the name, and return an `Insert` that rewrites the call site to the bare name (or
`root.name`) and pushes two declarations into the box's preamble: a
`var Box.<name> by Inheritance<T>()` and a `val Once.<name> by Onceing<T>()`. Both generated
lines carry the trailing empty-comment marker that makes the preamble gather copy them down into
child boxes, and an import for `T` is added via `kotlinImportStatementFor`. `macro_root_prop`
differs only in targeting `this.root`, so the accessors land on the document root rather than
on the calling box.

`src/jvmMain/kotlin/afield/stdlib/props.kt` — [read the source](source/jvmMain/afield/stdlib/props/)

## stdlib.kt { #stdlib-kt }

The general-purpose helpers that every Field box already has in scope.

Box code is compiled with `import afield.stdlib.*` in its preamble and with `Box` as an
implicit receiver, so everything here — including the `Box.` extensions — can be called
unqualified from inside a box.

The substantial part is the property-delegate machinery that `prop` and `@exported` generate
against: [`Delegation`](workspace.md#stdlib-kt-delegation) (stores on the receiver's own property bag), [`Inheritance`](workspace.md#stdlib-kt-inheritance) (walks up
`parents` until some ancestor has the property, otherwise throws
[`MissingInheritedPropertyException`](workspace.md#stdlib-kt-missinginheritedpropertyexception) with a message naming the property and the box), and
[`InheritanceFromContext`](workspace.md#stdlib-kt-inheritancefromcontext) (same walk, but prefers each box's live Kotlin variables over raw
properties).

The rest is small conveniences: graph access (`named`, `+=` / `-=` for
connect/disconnect, `__m` markers); execution control (`begin`, `end`, `start`, `animate`,
`aside`, `cell`); frame-presentation logging (`frameLogStart`, `frameLogStop`,
`frameLogMark`, `frameLogLine`); matrix and buffer building (`mat4`, `mat3`, `FloatBuffer.add`,
`IntBuffer.add`, `ByteBuffer.putf16`); and terse numeric/collection/string shorthands
(`Number.f` / `.i` / `.l` / `.d`, `fa`, `ia`, `Int.alphas`, `String.times`, `List.m` / `.s`,
`String.r`, and `highlightSyntax` behind `String.h` / `String.ss`).

`src/jvmMain/kotlin/afield/stdlib/stdlib.kt` — [read the source](source/jvmMain/afield/stdlib/stdlib/)

**Used in:** [Running code in a box](../running_code.md)

### Delegation { #stdlib-kt-delegation }

[<code class="highlight"><span class="k">class</span> <span class="nc">Delegation</span><span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nc">T</span><span class="p">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">var</span> <span class="n">onGet</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nc">HasProperties</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">currentValue</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">T</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">-&gt;</span> <span class="nc">Unit</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">?</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="k">var</span> <span class="n">hook</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">inside</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">HasProperties</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">currentValue</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">T</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">incomingValue</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">T</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">-&gt;</span> <span class="nc">T</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">?</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">defaultValue</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">-&gt;</span> <span class="nc">T</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">?</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">)</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/stdlib/stdlib/#L78)

The property delegate behind `prop` and `@exported`: reads and writes go to the receiver's own property bag under the property's name, not to a Kotlin field.

| Declaration | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| <code class="highlight"><span class="k">var</span> <span class="n">onGet</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nc">HasProperties</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">currentValue</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">T</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">-&gt;</span> <span class="nc">Unit</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">?</span></code> |  |
| <code class="highlight"><span class="k">var</span> <span class="n">hook</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">inside</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">HasProperties</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">currentValue</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">T</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">incomingValue</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">T</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">-&gt;</span> <span class="nc">T</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">?</span></code> |  |
| <code class="highlight"><span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">defaultValue</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">-&gt;</span> <span class="nc">T</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">?</span></code> |  |
| [<code class="highlight"><span class="k">operator</span> <span class="k">fun</span> <span class="nf">getValue</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">f</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">HasProperties</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">property</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">KProperty</span><span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="o">&#42;</span><span class="p">&gt;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">T</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/stdlib/stdlib/#L99) | Reads the property from `f`'s bag, filling in `defaultValue` on the first read if it is unset. |
| [<code class="highlight"><span class="k">operator</span> <span class="k">fun</span> <span class="nf">setValue</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">f</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">HasProperties</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">property</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">KProperty</span><span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="o">&#42;</span><span class="p">&gt;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">v</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">T</span><span class="p">)</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/stdlib/stdlib/#L129) | Writes the property into `f`'s bag, after letting `hook` rewrite the incoming value. |

### MissingInheritedPropertyException { #stdlib-kt-missinginheritedpropertyexception }

[<code class="highlight"><span class="k">class</span> <span class="nf">MissingInheritedPropertyException</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">message</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">String</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">IllegalStateException</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">message</span><span class="p">)</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/stdlib/stdlib/#L218)

Thrown when an inherited (`prop`-style) property has no value anywhere up the box graph and no default.

### Inheritance { #stdlib-kt-inheritance }

[<code class="highlight"><span class="k">class</span> <span class="nc">Inheritance</span><span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nc">T</span><span class="p">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">defaultValue</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">T</span><span class="o">?</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">)</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/stdlib/stdlib/#L299)

The property delegate that makes a value *inherited*: reading it looks in this box, then breadth-first up through `parents` until some ancestor has it.

| Declaration | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| [<code class="highlight"><span class="k">operator</span> <span class="k">fun</span> <span class="nf">getValue</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">f</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Box</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">property</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">KProperty</span><span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="o">&#42;</span><span class="p">&gt;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">T</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/stdlib/stdlib/#L307) | The value from this box or the nearest ancestor that has it. |
| [<code class="highlight"><span class="k">operator</span> <span class="k">fun</span> <span class="nf">setValue</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">f</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">HasHierarchy</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">property</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">KProperty</span><span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="o">&#42;</span><span class="p">&gt;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">v</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">T</span><span class="p">)</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/stdlib/stdlib/#L318) | Writes the value **locally**, shadowing any ancestor's value rather than modifying it. |

### InheritanceFromContext { #stdlib-kt-inheritancefromcontext }

[<code class="highlight"><span class="k">class</span> <span class="nc">InheritanceFromContext</span><span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nc">T</span><span class="p">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">defaultValue</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">T</span><span class="o">?</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">)</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/stdlib/stdlib/#L333)

[`Inheritance`](workspace.md#stdlib-kt-inheritance), but it can also see the *live Kotlin variables* of the boxes it walks — so a plain `val speed = 3.0` in a parent box is inheritable, with no property or annotation needed.

| Declaration | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| [<code class="highlight"><span class="k">operator</span> <span class="k">fun</span> <span class="nf">getValue</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">f</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Box</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">property</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">KProperty</span><span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="o">&#42;</span><span class="p">&gt;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">T</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/stdlib/stdlib/#L340) | The value from this box or the nearest ancestor, preferring live Kotlin variables over properties. |
| [<code class="highlight"><span class="k">operator</span> <span class="k">fun</span> <span class="nf">setValue</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">f</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">HasHierarchy</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">property</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">KProperty</span><span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="o">&#42;</span><span class="p">&gt;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">v</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">T</span><span class="p">)</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/stdlib/stdlib/#L369) | Writes the value **locally** as a raw property, shadowing whatever an ancestor had. |

### Marker { #stdlib-kt-marker }

[<code class="highlight"><span class="k">data</span> <span class="k">class</span> <span class="nf">Marker</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">name</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">String</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">box</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Box</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">HasProperties</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nc">HasHierarchy</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/stdlib/stdlib/#L867)

A named property bag attached to a box — somewhere to hang state that belongs to *part* of a box rather than to the box itself.

| Declaration | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| [<code class="highlight"><span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">properties</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/stdlib/stdlib/#L869) | This marker's state, as a plain map. In memory only; nothing here is persisted with the document. |
| [<code class="highlight"><span class="k">override</span> <span class="k">fun</span> <span class="nf">setPropertyRaw</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">name</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">String</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="k">value</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Any</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">doResync</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Boolean</span><span class="p">)</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/stdlib/stdlib/#L872) | Stores a value under `name`. The `doResync` flag is ignored — a marker has no client to notify. |
| [<code class="highlight"><span class="k">override</span> <span class="k">fun</span> <span class="nf">getPropertyRaw</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">name</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">String</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">default</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Any</span><span class="o">?</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Any</span><span class="o">?</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/stdlib/stdlib/#L877) | The value stored under `name`, or `default` if this marker has never been given one. |
| [<code class="highlight"><span class="k">override</span> <span class="k">fun</span> <span class="nf">removePropertyRaw</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">name</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">String</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">doResync</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Boolean</span><span class="p">)</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/stdlib/stdlib/#L882) | Erases `name`. The `doResync` flag is ignored — a marker has no client to notify. |
| [<code class="highlight"><span class="k">override</span> <span class="k">var</span> <span class="n">children</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">MutableSet</span><span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nc">Box</span><span class="p">&gt;</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/stdlib/stdlib/#L887) | Always empty: a marker is a leaf. Assigning to it does nothing. |
| [<code class="highlight"><span class="k">override</span> <span class="k">var</span> <span class="n">parents</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">MutableSet</span><span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nc">Box</span><span class="p">&gt;</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/stdlib/stdlib/#L892) | Just the owning box, so a parent walk reaches it. Assigning to it does nothing. |

### Vec2h { #stdlib-kt-vec2h }

[<code class="highlight"><span class="k">typealias</span> <span class="nc">Vec2h</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">afield</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">four</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">util</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nc">Vec2h</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/stdlib/stdlib/#L938)

A pair of 16-bit half floats, for packed vertex attributes and uniforms. Half the bytes of a [`Vec2`](math.md#linalg-kt-vec2), a fraction of the precision — see `ByteBuffer.putf16` for the range.

### Vec3h { #stdlib-kt-vec3h }

[<code class="highlight"><span class="k">typealias</span> <span class="nc">Vec3h</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">afield</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">four</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">util</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nc">Vec3h</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/stdlib/stdlib/#L941)

Three 16-bit half floats — the packed transit form of a `Vec3` for GPU buffers.

### Vec4h { #stdlib-kt-vec4h }

[<code class="highlight"><span class="k">typealias</span> <span class="nc">Vec4h</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">afield</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">four</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">util</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nc">Vec4h</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/stdlib/stdlib/#L944)

Four 16-bit half floats — the packed transit form of a [`Vec4`](math.md#linalg-kt-vec4), and enough precision for a colour.
